第3章 系统是大爷 靠它装逼带飞（第1页）
“系统，商城开启失败，你不是还可以签到吗？我现在选择签到”
林羽也是承认自己是穷逼了，没办法，事实摆在眼前。
等了一会，系统没有声音，林羽催促道；
“系统，系统，给我签到啊，你这是不是太磨蹭了？”
“本系统忘记了，正在加载日常签到功能程序”
“叮咚，加载完成，请问宿主是否签到”
“签到”林羽心中急念，大为期待能得到什么宝物。
“叮咚，系统商城开启条件已触发，正在加载商城…”
“叮咚，商城已开启成功，宿主可凭意念查看”
林羽迫不及待的急忙查看，发现商城宝物，真的是满目琳琅，只不过这价格也太……
可借天道之力，简称天道宠儿，出个门都能捡到绝世神物。
可以截断时间长河，可以来回穿梭于虚空世界。
掌人生死，一念之间，一眼就能让人沉沦无间。
天生至尊，万古独尊之势，有我无敌。
神体不出，圣体唯一，圣体大成，可战大帝，据传君家的君傲天就是荒古圣体。
圣体宿敌，可御天地霸气，加临己身，遇强则强。
还有很多宝物，什么大帝道果，妖帝肉身，准帝遗骸。
拥有三千道则的世界树，助人顿悟的悟道茶，增加神魂的菩提子，三十六品混沌青莲，诸多等等……
林羽心想，不知系统回收荒古圣体不，要是可以，把君傲天绑了撕票，那就发财了。
“宿主，你的想法有点危险，不过本系统喜欢，只是回收价格只有系统售卖的一成，也就是说回收圣体，只有五百万亿系统币”
倒吸冷气，这系统真特马的黑，这水抽的直接见底。
“叮咚，本系统警告宿主诽谤本系统一次，若有再犯，将扣除系统币作惩罚，五千系统币一次，上不封顶，可预扣，发现宿主有钱主动扣除还上”
林羽一听，只感心中万马奔腾，却没处可去。
“系统，你这一万系统币毫无用处啊”林羽有些无语，不知道还好，看到了那么多宝物，却没有钱，心更痒了。
“本系统建议宿主眼界放低点，再放低点”
林羽直接翻到最后一页，得还真有，
空间戒指，九千九百九十九个系统币，再往上的什么灵体。
再往上，什么法宝，丹药，都是十万加，一万以下就一个。
可是只买个空间戒指没啥用啊，啥都没有，更何况不是有系统空间吗。
前世看过一些牛逼系统流小说，可以连上古神山都能收进去的，自己应该没必要浪费系统币了。
“系统，系统本身是不是就有储物空间”
“宿主，你想的是不是有点多了，本系统当然也是很牛逼的，只是要出自本系统才能储物，外界物品是放不进来的，除了回收”。
“另外友情提示宿主，初次开启系统商城，宿主必须要购买东西，本系统不能刚刚开张就空手而归”
得，林羽感受被系统安排的明明白白的。
话说到这份上，林羽能怎么办，只能照办啊？
没办法，系统是大爷，今后还要靠大爷罩着。
在这个呼风唤雨，追星捉月的世界里，好好的生存下来，一步一步的走向巅峰。
“嗯，不错不错，宿主的心态很好，位置摆得很端正，再接再厉，说不定本系统一时觉得爽了，给你爆点宝物出来”。
“是，是，是，以后你就是我大爷，以后就靠大爷带我装逼带我飞”
林羽他低头了，别人的系统听宿主的，而他的是宿主听系统的。

Chapter 3 The system is the master, rely on it to show off and lead the way (Page 1)
"System, the mall failed to open, can't you still sign in? I choose to sign in now"
Lin Yu also admitted that he was poor and had no choice. The facts were before his eyes.
After waiting for a while, there was no sound from the system, and Lin Yu urged;
"System, system, sign in for me. Are you taking your time too much?"
"This system has forgotten and is loading the daily check-in function program"
"Ding dong, loading is complete, would you like to ask the host to sign in?"
"Sign in" Lin Yu thought anxiously, looking forward to what treasures he could get.
"Ding dong, the system mall opening condition has been triggered, and the mall is loading..."
"Ding dong, the mall has been opened successfully, the host can view it with his mind."
Lin Yu couldn't wait to check it out in a hurry and found that the treasures in the mall were really dazzling, but the price was too...
You can borrow the power of Heaven, called Heaven's Favorite for short, and you can pick up peerless divine objects wherever you go out.
It can cut off the long river of time and travel back and forth through the void world.
Controlling life and death, a single thought and a glance can make people sink into oblivion.
Born to be supreme, I have the power to be supreme throughout the ages, and I am invincible.
The divine body cannot come out, but the holy body is the only one. The holy body is so perfect that it can fight the emperor. It is said that Jun Aotian of the Jun family is the ancient holy body.
The old enemy of the holy body can control the domineering force of heaven and earth, and attack oneself, and become stronger when encountering strength.
There are also many treasures, such as the Great Emperor's Dao Fruit, the Demon Emperor's body, and the remains of the Quasi-Emperor.
The world tree with three thousand principles, the enlightenment tea that helps people realize enlightenment, the bodhi seed that increases the soul, the thirty-sixth grade chaotic green lotus, and so on...
Lin Yu thought to himself, I wonder if the system can recycle the ancient holy body. If possible, he could make a fortune by tying up Jun Aotian.
"Host, your idea is a bit dangerous, but this system likes it, but the recycling price is only 10% of what the system sells. In other words, recycling the holy body only costs 50 billion system coins."
I sucked in the cold air, this system is really dark, the water is pumping straight to the bottom.
"Ding dong, this system warns the host to slander the system once. If he does it again, system coins will be deducted as punishment. Five thousand system coins will be deducted once. There is no upper limit. It can be withheld. If the host has money, he will take the initiative to deduct and pay back."
When Lin Yu heard this, he felt that thousands of horses were galloping in his heart, but he had nowhere to go.
"System, your ten thousand system coins are useless." Lin Yu was speechless. He didn't know what to do. He saw so many treasures but had no money, which made his heart itch even more.
"This system recommends that the host set his sights lower, and then lower his horizons even further."
Lin Yu turned directly to the last page. It was really there.
A space ring, nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine system coins, and some spiritual body above that.
Going further up, any magic weapon or elixir costs more than one hundred thousand, and only one is less than ten thousand.
But just buying a space ring is of no use, it has nothing, let alone system space.
In my previous life, I had read some awesome system novels, which could even be included in the ancient sacred mountains. There should be no need for me to waste system coins.
"System, does the system itself have storage space?"
"Host, are you thinking too much? This system is of course very powerful. It just needs to come from this system to store items. External items cannot be put in, except for recycling."
"In addition, a friendly reminder to the host, when opening the system mall for the first time, the host must purchase something. This system cannot be returned empty-handed just after opening."
Yes, Lin Yu felt clearly arranged by the system.
Speaking of this, what can Lin Yu do but just do as he is told?
There is no way, the system is the boss, and I will have to rely on the boss to protect me from now on.
In this world where you can control the wind and rain, chase stars and catch the moon, survive well and reach the top step by step.
"Well, not bad, the host's mentality is very good, and the position is very correct. If you keep up the good work, maybe this system will feel happy for a while and give you some treasures."
"Yes, yes, yes, you will be my uncle from now on. From now on, I will rely on you to lead me to show off and fly."
Lin Yu lowered his head. Other people's systems listened to the host, but his was the host listening to the system.
